facts.fact: The ICT minister told the Senate defence committee that work is under way to develop the capabilities of EG-CERT, the National Center for Computer and Network Emergency Readiness under NTRA, using AI against cyber threats.
facts.system: EG-CERT (National Center for Computer and Network Emergency Readiness, NTRA)

facts.fact: The minister said the second edition of the National Cybersecurity Strategy is being implemented through projects to protect digital infrastructure; its period is not stated, and a third edition is in preparation (not recorded as a fact).

systems.system: EG-CERT (National Center for Computer and Network Emergency Readiness)
